raw_notes.frequent_confusion:
Frequently forgets where her glasses are kept.
Sometimes asks whether she has already taken her morning medicine.
Occasionally forgets what day of the week it is.
Sometimes worries that she needs to go home even though she is already at home.
May ask repeatedly when her son Rajesh is coming.
Sometimes forgets that she already had her afternoon tea.
raw_notes.doctor_notes:
Take medicines strictly according to the prescribed schedule.
Drink water regularly throughout the day.
Take a short supervised walk each morning.
Avoid skipping breakfast before morning medicines.
Keep the walking stick nearby while walking.
Family member should assist with medication confirmation.
Maintain a calm environment and gently reassure the patient when confused.
Follow the prescribed diet and attend scheduled medical appointments.
